notes: Country Road (countryroad.com.au, AU) - checked for a Home/homewares-scoped Bestsellers-type PLP. (1) Full plp-au-sitemap.xml grepped case-insensitively for 'best': only /woman-our-edits-best-sellers/ and /man-our-edits-best-sellers/ exist; no /home-our-edits-best-sellers/ or any home-scoped equivalent despite Woman and Man each having one - strong structural signal the site never built this concept for Home. (2) Main homepage HTML (www.countryroad.com.au) has zero occurrences of best/bestseller/popular/trending/favourite/most-loved/top sellers anywhere in header, mega-menu markup, or footer. (3) Outlet subdomain homepage (outlet.countryroad.com.au) also has zero occurrences of 'best' anywhere in its nav/footer. (4) Site's own search was tested: ?q=bestsellers returned ProductLanding.totalCount=993, but a control query for a nonsense string (?q=zzzznonsensequery123) returned totalCount=1000 - i.e. the search endpoint returns a near-full-catalog count regardless of query and does not discriminate; the 993 figure for 'bestsellers' is not evidence of a genuine Bestsellers listing (site search false-absence/false-positive risk both ways, per project convention). (5) /home-edits/ and /home-our-editorials/ (found in sitemap, sound editorial-ish) were opened and both resolve to the exact same categoryId (158914) and content as /home-new-in/, a New Arrivals listing - not Bestsellers, no bestseller framing anywhere on the page. Conclusion: no genuine Bestsellers / Top Sellers / Most Popular / Customer Favourites PLP exists for the Home range on either the main site or its Outlet subdomain. Access: direct curl_cffi HTTP fetch with chrome124 impersonation succeeded on every URL (200s throughout, matches prior pass's finding that chrome124/123/119/safari17_0/safari15_5/firefox133 profiles pass Cloudflare cleanly); no Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome tier needed. robots.txt on both www and outlet subdomains checked - no Claude-specific disallow.
